example.en: The boutique waterfront hotel provided a very nice atmosphere for the annual networking gala.
example.zh: 這間濱水精品飯店為年度人脈交流晚會提供了非常舒適美好的氛圍。

words.mnemonic: 評價環境或待人親切常用詞：have a nice stay (祝您住宿愉快)。

example.en: The invoice clearly states the total amount due including applicable shipping and handling fees.
example.zh: 發票上明確載明了應付總金額，包含適用的運費與處理費。

words.mnemonic: 修飾不可數名詞或款項：amount of money (金額)、total amount (總額)。

example.en: High-resolution pictures of our latest product line are available in the online press kit.
example.zh: 我們最新產品線的高解析度照片已備置於線上媒體新聞發布資料包中。

words.mnemonic: 行銷圖片與總體情勢：take a picture (拍照)、the big picture (整體大局)。

example.en: The sporting goods company launched an apparel marketing campaign targeting active teenage boys.
example.zh: 這家體育用品公司推出了一場鎖定活躍青少年族群的運動服飾行銷宣傳。

words.mnemonic: 服飾銷售與公眾慈善常見客群名詞。

example.en: I am writing to inquire about your company's latest policy with regard to remote work arrangements.
example.zh: 我特此致函，就貴公司有關遠距工作安排的最新政策進行洽詢。

words.mnemonic: 多益公文兩大王牌：with regard to (關於/就...而言)、Best regards (祝好/信末敬上)。

example.en: Our international charitable organization relies on corporate sponsorships to fund disaster relief.
example.zh: 我們的國際慈善組織仰賴企業贊助來籌措災難救助資金。

words.mnemonic: 非營利機構常客：non-profit organization (NPO, 非營利組織)。

example.en: We would be very happy to arrange a private demonstration of the software at your convenience.
example.zh: 在您方便之際，我們將非常樂意為您安排該軟體的專屬示範操作。

words.mnemonic: 客氣商業書信常用：be happy to do something (樂意做某事)。

example.en: The project supervisor requested a couple of extra days to finalize the environmental report.
example.zh: 專案主管請求多給幾天額外時間以定稿環境評估報告。

words.mnemonic: 極高頻口語時間片語：a couple of days (幾天時間)。

example.en: Corporate management must act promptly to investigate employee reports of software piracy.
example.zh: 企業管理層必須迅速採取行動以調查員工回報的軟體盜版情事。

words.mnemonic: 行動與代理職責：act as (擔任/充當)、act promptly (迅速行動)。

example.en: Our downtown showroom features a wide range of ergonomic office furniture and accessories.
example.zh: 我們的市中心展示門市陳列了各色各樣符合人體工學的辦公家具與配件。

words.mnemonic: 多益最愛考片語：a wide range of (種類繁多的/廣泛的)。

example.en: Our manufacturing plant is renowned for producing exceptionally high quality electronic components.
example.zh: 我們的製造廠以生產極高品質的電子零組件而享譽業界。

words.mnemonic: 品質保證核心字：quality control (品管/QC)、high quality (高品質)。

example.en: The senior project manager scheduled a weekly review meeting to monitor construction milestones.
example.zh: 資深專案經理安排了一次每週檢討會以監督工程里程碑。

words.mnemonic: 專案管理必備：project manager (專案經理)、manage a project (管理專案)。
roots: ject 丟 → 向前拋出的計畫

example.en: Business travelers booked round-trip airline tickets between New York and London.
example.zh: 商務旅客預訂了往返紐約與倫敦之間的來回機票。

words.mnemonic: 機票與面試大考點：round-trip ticket (來回機票)、first round of interviews (第一輪面試)。

example.en: This international internship offers a valuable opportunity to gain professional experience.
example.zh: 這次國際實習提供了一個獲取專業實務經驗的寶貴機會。

words.mnemonic: 求職與商務必背：job opportunity (工作機會)、equal opportunity (平等機會)。
roots: -unity 名詞 → 順風抵港的時機

example.en: The city transportation department announced scheduled road maintenance near the conference hall.
example.zh: 市交通局宣布了會展中心附近定時進行的道路維護施工。

words.mnemonic: 商旅出差常用：on the road (出差奔波在途)。

example.en: According to the corporate travel policy, all lodging expenses must be approved in advance.
example.zh: 依據企業差旅管理辦法，所有住宿費用皆必須事先獲得核准。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀出題頻率最高片語：according to (根據/依據)。

example.en: Please check the attached price list for discounted corporate software license rates.
example.zh: 請查閱附件價目表以了解優惠的企業軟體授權費率。

words.mnemonic: 商業文具清單：price list (價目表)、waiting list (候補名單)。

example.en: If you wish to cancel or modify your conference registration, please notify us before Friday.
example.zh: 若您希望取消或更改研討會報名，請於週五前通知我們。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信客氣表達：if you wish to do something (如果您希望做某事)。

example.en: Severe storms delayed incoming component shipments; therefore, factory assembly was postponed.
example.zh: 強烈暴風雨延誤了零組件的進口運輸；因此，工廠組裝作業被迫延後。

words.mnemonic: 因果推論副詞，引出必然的結論或相應處置措施。

example.en: All factory visitors must wear hard hats and protective goggles inside the production facility.
example.zh: 所有工廠訪客在生產廠房內皆必須配戴安全帽與防護護目鏡。

words.mnemonic: 多益工安服儀規定：wear a badge (配戴識別證)、wear and tear (正常磨損)。

example.en: The corporate steering committee approved additional funds to expand our research laboratory.
example.zh: 企業指導委員會核准了額外資金以擴充我們的研發實驗室。

words.mnemonic: 金融資助核心詞：raise funds (籌募資金)、mutual fund (共同基金)。

example.en: The team finished the initial design phase and will complete the rest of the project next month.
example.zh: 團隊完成了初期設計階段，將於下個月完成該專案的其餘部分。

words.mnemonic: 剩餘事務常用片語：the rest of (其餘的/剩下的)。

example.en: The family resort hotel provides dedicated recreational play areas for guests traveling with kids.
example.zh: 該家庭度假飯店為帶兒童出遊的旅客提供專門的休閒娛樂遊憩區。

words.mnemonic: 休閒飯店與親子方案常客：kids club (兒童俱樂部)。

example.en: Our corporation has established itself as an innovative leader in the renewable energy industry.
example.zh: 我們企業已建立起自身在再生能源產業中創新領航者的地位。

words.mnemonic: 產業地位描述：industry leader (產業龍頭)、industry standard (業界標準)。

example.en: The corporate employee benefits policy includes tuition reimbursement for continuing education.
example.zh: 企業員工福利政策包含了在職進修教育的學費補助報銷。

words.mnemonic: 在職進修考點：continuing education (進修教育)、higher education (高等教育)。

example.en: Factory management implemented strict security measures to prevent unauthorized data access.
example.zh: 工廠管理層落實了嚴格的安全措施以防範未經授權的資料存取。

words.mnemonic: 落實措施搭配：take measures (採取措施)、preventive measure (預防措施)。

example.en: The executive committee decided to kill the unprofitable project due to rising supply expenses.
example.zh: 執行委員會因供應成本攀升而決定終止這項不賺錢的專案。

words.mnemonic: 多益商務口語常考：kill a project / kill a deal (終止專案/取消交易)。

example.en: The hotel restaurant will serve a complimentary continental breakfast between six and nine.
example.zh: 飯店餐廳將在六點至九點之間供應免費的歐陸式早餐。

words.mnemonic: 餐廳供餐與任職：serve breakfast (供應早餐)、serve as manager (擔任經理)。

example.en: The proposed corporate tax reform is likely to impact second quarter capital investments.
example.zh: 擬議的企業稅改法案很有可能會對第二季度的資本投資產生影響。

words.mnemonic: 多益極高頻句型：be likely to + 原形動詞 (很有可能做某事)。

example.en: Our support department will certainly investigate your billing inquiry without any delay.
example.zh: 我們的支援部門必定會毫不延誤地深入調查您的帳單問題。

words.mnemonic: 肯定承諾回應詞：Certainly, I can help you with that。

example.en: Our logistics network provides fast and reliable national delivery across the contiguous states.
example.zh: 我們的物流網絡在全美相鄰各州提供迅速且可靠的全國貨物配送服務。

words.mnemonic: 全國性範圍：national holiday (國定假日)、national conference (全國年會)。

example.en: The automated software updates itself every Sunday evening during off-peak network hours.
example.zh: 該自動化軟體每週日傍晚離峰時段會自我進行自動更新。

words.mnemonic: 事物本身反身代名詞：in itself (本身而言)。

example.en: Experienced systems engineers will teach newly recruited developers how to utilize the internal framework.
example.zh: 資深系統工程師將指導新進開發者如何使用內部開發架構。

words.mnemonic: 內部培訓動作動詞：teach someone how to do something。

example.en: The applicant possesses over fifteen years of distinguished professional experience in the field of telecommunications.
example.zh: 該應徵者在電信領域擁有超過十五年傑出的專業資歷。

words.mnemonic: 專業範疇與外勤：in the field of (在...領域)、field service (外勤維修服務)。

example.en: All passengers must pass through airport security checkpoints prior to boarding flights.
example.zh: 所有旅客在登機之前皆必須通過機場安全檢查關卡。

words.mnemonic: 安全設施大考點：security badge (識別證)、security checkpoint (安檢處)。

example.en: Corporate business packages include discounted air travel fares with our commercial airline partners.
example.zh: 企業商務套裝方案包含我們商業合作航空公司提供的折扣航空機票價格。

words.mnemonic: 航空與空調常用字：air freight (空運)、air conditioning (空調冷氣)。

example.en: Our marketing delegation will host a promotional booth at the upcoming international trade expo.
example.zh: 我們的行銷代表團將在即將舉行的國際貿易博覽會上設置宣傳攤位。

words.mnemonic: 商貿展覽必備：trade show / trade fair (商展)、free trade (自由貿易)。

example.en: Companies should implement robust cybersecurity protocols to reduce the risk of sensitive data breaches.
example.zh: 企業應實施穩健的網路安全協定以降低敏感資料外洩的風險。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業風險管理搭配：risk management (風險管理)、at risk (面臨風險)。

example.en: The corporate communications team issued a news release regarding the company merger today.
example.zh: 企業公關傳播團隊今日針對公司合併事宜發布了一份新聞稿。

words.mnemonic: 不可數名詞大考點：news release / press release (新聞稿)。

example.en: All electronic components manufactured in our plant meet international environmental safety standards.
example.zh: 我們工廠製造的所有電子組件皆符合國際環境安全標準。

words.mnemonic: 符合標準搭配動詞：meet standards (符合標準)、safety standard (安全標準)。

example.en: Clients can pay their consulting invoices conveniently via electronic bank transfer.
example.zh: 客戶可以透過電子銀行轉帳便捷地支付其顧問諮詢費用帳單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 付款與注意力高頻動詞：pay by credit card (刷卡付款)、pay attention to (注意)。

example.en: The enterprise strives to build lasting relationships with its corporate suppliers and clients.
example.zh: 該企業致力於與其企業供應商及客戶建立長久穩固的合作關係。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務擴張與公關常用：build relationships (建立關係)。

example.en: Please hold the line while I transfer your call to the technical service department.
example.zh: 請稍候別掛斷，我將為您把電話轉接至技術服務部。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 電話英語與主辦會議極高頻：hold the line (電話稍候)、hold a meeting (開會)。

example.en: Our award-winning customer service department handles inquiries promptly around the clock.
example.zh: 我們屢獲殊榮的客戶服務部門全天候迅速處理顧客諮詢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最重要的主題名詞：customer service (客服)、service charge (服務費)。

example.en: Heavy equipment should be placed securely against the back wall of the factory storage bay.
example.zh: 重型設備應穩固地放置在工廠倉儲區的後牆邊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益聽力 Part 1 常見方位介系詞：leaning against the wall (靠在牆上)。

example.en: Industry experts believe that renewable solar energy adoption will accelerate over the coming decade.
example.zh: 產業專家認為，在未來的十年間，再生太陽能的普及將會加速。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業演說表達樂觀展望時常用：believe that (深信/認為)。

example.en: The second quarter fiscal earnings report will be presented to shareholders on Thursday.
example.zh: 第二季度會計盈餘報告將於週四向股東呈報。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財報與步驟標記詞：second quarter (第二季/Q2)、second floor (二樓)。

example.en: Even though initial production was delayed, the engineering team finished the project ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 儘管初期生產有所延誤，工程團隊仍提前完成了專案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 轉折句型重點：even though (即使/儘管)。

example.en: We would love to welcome your delegation to our annual international software summit.
example.zh: 我們非常樂意歡迎貴代表團出席我們的年度國際軟體峰會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 邀請函常用客氣句型：would love to (非常樂意做某事)。

example.en: Human resources published a job advertisement for a bilingual corporate communications specialist.
example.zh: 人力資源部門刊登了一則徵求雙語企業傳播專員的徵才廣告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 徵才招聘核心字：job opening (職缺)、job description (工作職責說明)。

example.en: The corporate steering committee reviewed the proposed marketing plan during this morning's session.

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場規劃必備詞：business plan (商業計畫書)、plan to (打算做某事)。

example.en: As a result of the targeted promotional campaign, third quarter retail sales surged twenty percent.
example.zh: 由於精準推廣活動的成效，第三季零售額大幅增長了百分之二十。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 因果關係極高頻轉折片語：as a result of (由於...的結果)。

example.en: Mr. Sterling is currently away on a business trip, but his assistant can answer your inquiries.
example.zh: 史特林先生目前出差在外，但他的助理可以回答您的洽詢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 不在辦公室常用答覆：away on business (出差中)；right away (立刻)。

example.en: The training seminar leader cited several successful examples of corporate brand turnaround.
example.zh: 培訓研討會講師列舉了數個企業品牌成功轉型翻身的範例。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議舉例最常見片語：for example (例如)。

example.en: If a delivery disruption happens to occur, customers will receive immediate automated notification.
example.zh: 萬一碰巧發生出貨配送中斷，顧客將收到即時自動通知。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 事件發生描寫動詞：happen to (碰巧)。

example.en: We are delighted to offer you the position of senior financial analyst at our corporate headquarters.
example.zh: 我們非常榮幸能向您提供企業總部資深財務分析師的職位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 求職錄取與商業優惠必備：job offer (錄取通知)、special offer (特別優惠)。
roots: fer 攜帶 → 帶到面前

example.en: The internship program provides promising young professionals with hands-on corporate experience.
example.zh: 該實習計畫為極具潛力的年輕專業人士提供寶貴的企業實務經驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 實習培訓與消費市場客群詞彙：young professionals (青年專業人才)。

example.en: The downtown commercial bank branch closes promptly at five o'clock on weekday afternoons.
example.zh: 市中心商銀分行於平日下午五點整準時結束營業打烊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 營業時間公告核心詞：close at 5 PM；片語 close a deal (達成交易)。

example.en: All newly hired administrative employees must attend our comprehensive orientation program.
example.zh: 所有新聘行政人員皆必須參加我們全面的到職培訓計畫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資培訓方案：training program (培訓計畫)、loyalty program (會員積點計畫)。

example.en: Ms. Reynolds was appointed to lead the international software development initiative.
example.zh: 雷諾茲女士獲任命領導這項國際軟體開發倡議。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場領導力與因果搭配：lead to (導致)、lead a team (帶領團隊)。

example.en: Corporate clients can buy office furniture in bulk to receive substantial volume discounts.
example.zh: 企業客戶可以大宗批量購買辦公家具，以獲得豐厚的量大折扣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 採購基礎動詞：buy in bulk (大宗購買)、buy online (線上購買)。

example.en: We completely understand your frustration regarding the unexpected shipment delay.
example.zh: 我們非常能體諒您對於無預警貨物延誤所感到的沮喪。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服書信展現同理心必用動詞：understand your concern (體諒您的關切)。

example.en: We would like to thank all participating vendors for their valuable contributions to the trade expo.
example.zh: 我們由衷感謝所有參展廠商對本次貿易博覽會所做出的寶貴貢獻。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務社交信函第一句或結尾句：Thank you for your cooperation (感謝您的合作)。

example.en: The corporate conference center is not far from the international airport terminals.
example.zh: 該企業會議中心距離國際機場航廈並不遙遠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益聽力短對話方位詞：not far from (離...不遠)；as far as (就...而言)。

example.en: Order your replacement supplies today to qualify for free express courier dispatch.
example.zh: 今日下單訂購您的耗材補充品，即可享有免費快捷快遞出貨服務。

example.zh: 標準企業辦公營業時間為上午九點至下午五點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 營業與辦公時間多益必考：business hours / office hours (營業/辦公時間)。

example.en: Full-time university students are eligible for a twenty percent discount on exhibition passes.
example.zh: 全職大學生可享有展覽入場證八折優惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 學生票價促銷與實習生招募考點：student discount (學生優惠)。

example.zh: 在地零售商正面臨來自跨國線上電商平台的激烈競爭。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場商業挑戰動詞：face challenges / face competition (面臨挑戰/競爭)。

example.zh: 我們期盼能在週五之前敲定與海外供應商的合約談判。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信期許句型：We hope that... / hope to do something。

example.zh: 設計團隊針對環保產品包裝提出了一個創新的構想。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 腦力激盪常用詞：innovative idea (創新點子)。

example.zh: 導入數位自動化幫助我們的工廠將整體營運成本降低了百分之十。

example.en: Our creative marketing team collaborated with outside consultants to design the advertising campaign.
example.zh: 我們的創意行銷團隊與外部顧問通力合作，以規劃設計該廣告宣傳企劃。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場核心名詞：team member (團隊成員)、team leader (組長)。

example.en: Our newly launched mobile portal makes it easy for clients to track their shipments in real time.
example.zh: 我們新推出的行動平台讓客戶能夠輕鬆即時追蹤其貨物運送狀態。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 產品特色描述句型：make it easy to do (使...變得容易/簡便)。

example.en: The training program is customized to meet the unique learning needs of each individual employee.
example.zh: 該培訓計畫量身打造，以滿足每位個別員工獨特的學習需求。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 個人化與客製化：individual needs (個別需求)、individual contribution (個人貢獻)。
roots: -ual 形容詞 → 不可再分的

example.en: The corporate client received a full refund after their shipment was accidentally damaged in transit.
example.zh: 在貨件於運輸途中意外受損後，企業客戶獲得了全額退款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人事與退款高頻詞：full refund (全額退款)、full-time employee (全職員工)。

example.en: Thanks to rigorous budget management, the enterprise operated comfortably in the black this quarter.
example.zh: 歸功於嚴謹的預算管理，該企業本季度穩健處於獲利盈餘狀態。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商務隱喻大考點：in the black (獲利/有盈餘)，與 in the red (虧損) 相反！

example.en: From an operational perspective, it makes commercial sense to automate repetitive invoice entries.
example.zh: 從營運角度來看，將重複性的發票登錄作業自動化在商業上十分合理可行。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務提案合理性片語：make sense (合乎邏輯/有道理)。

example.en: Perhaps we should reschedule the project review meeting to allow more time for data collection.
example.zh: 也許我們應該將專案審核會議改期，以預留更多資料收集的時間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議中提出委婉建議時的常用句首副詞。

example.en: The developer added several advanced encryption features to the cloud software platform.
example.zh: 開發者在雲端軟體平台中增添了數項高階加密功能。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 附加功能與補充片語：add value (增添價值)、in addition to (除了...之外)。

example.en: All factory operators must strictly abide by workplace safety rules while on the assembly line.
example.zh: 所有工廠作業員在組裝線上作業時均必須嚴格遵守職場安全規則。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 守規矩常考搭配：follow the rules / obey the rules (遵守規則)。

example.en: All conference delegates must display their official security pass to enter the main auditorium.
example.zh: 所有研討會代表必須出示其正式安全通行證以進入主禮堂。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 證件與測驗名詞/動詞：boarding pass (登機證)、pass an inspection (通過檢驗)。

example.en: The newly upgraded manufacturing facility can produce over ten thousand units per day.
example.zh: 新升級的製造廠每天可生產超過一萬件產品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 動詞 /prəˈduːs/ (製造)；名詞 /ˈprɑːduːs/ (農產品，如 fresh produce)。
roots: duc 引導 → 引出、生產

example.en: Retail stores sell surplus seasonal inventory at discounted clearance rates during January.
example.zh: 零售店在元月份期間以優惠的清倉折價販售剩餘的當季庫存。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 熱賣常用詞：sell out (售罄/賣光)、bestseller (暢銷商品)。

example.en: The supervisor held a short orientation meeting to introduce newly recruited staff to the team.
example.zh: 主管舉行了一次簡短的培訓會議，將新進員工介紹給團隊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益常見時間與人力短缺片語：short-term (短期)、short on staff (人手短缺)。

example.en: Both contracting parties agreed to the amended delivery timetable proposed by the manufacturer.
example.zh: 雙方締約方皆同意製造商所提出的修訂出貨時程表。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務協議核心動詞：agree on terms (同意條款)、agree to a proposal (同意提案)。

example.en: The corporate legal counsel ensures that all regional business contracts comply with labor laws.
example.zh: 企業法律顧問確保所有區域商務合約皆符合勞動法規。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務法務名詞：comply with the law (遵守法律)、law firm (法律事務所)。

example.en: The executive administrative assistant ensured that everything was prepared for the board meeting.
example.zh: 執行行政助理確保董事會會議的一切準備工作皆已就緒。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 全體事項準備就緒用語：everything is ready (一切就緒)。

example.en: Extensive consumer market research was conducted prior to unveiling our new electric vehicle.
example.zh: 在發表我們的新型電動車之前，進行了廣泛的消費者市場研究。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 研發與市調必考詞：market research (市場調查)、conduct research (進行研究)。

example.en: The company's comprehensive travel policy will cover all standard lodging and meal expenses.
example.zh: 公司的差旅管理辦法將涵蓋支付所有標準住宿與膳食費用。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重考法：cover expenses (支付費用)、cover letter (求職信)。

example.en: The hiring committee will select the most qualified candidate for the manager post.
example.zh: 聘雇委員會將挑選出最適任該經理職位的人選。

reviewWords.mnemonic: se- (分開) + lect (挑選) ＝ 從眾多之中挑出。

example.en: The resort hotel is surrounded by tranquil tropical gardens and sandy beaches.
example.zh: 該度假飯店被寧靜的熱帶花園與沙灘所圍繞。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sur- (在上方、超過) + round (圓) ＝ 繞成一圈圍住。

example.en: Management launched an assessment to determine the full extent of the factory damage.
example.zh: 管理階層展開評估，以確定工廠受損的完整程度與範圍。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (向外) + tend (伸展) ＝ 伸展到的距離 ＝ 程度、範圍。

example.en: The convention center offers scenic river views from all banquet hall rooms.
example.zh: 會議中心的所有宴會廳皆享有優美的河景風光。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常見飯店地段描述：river view (河景客房)、river cruise (遊船)。

example.en: Please ensure the corporate registration form is fully completed before submission.
example.zh: 提交之前，請務必確認企業註冊表格已完全填寫無誤。

reviewWords.mnemonic: full (滿的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 完全地、充分地。

example.en: In sharp contrast to last quarter, corporate retail revenues increased by twelve percent.
example.zh: 與上一季形成鮮明對比的是，企業零售營收增長了百分之十二。

reviewWords.mnemonic: contra- (反對、相反) + st (站立) ＝ 相反兩者擺在一起 ＝ 對比。

example.en: The telecommunications giant plans to roll out its fiber network nationwide this spring.
example.zh: 這家電信巨頭計劃於今年春季在全國範圍內推出鋪設其光纖網路。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益極高頻片語：roll out (正式推出新產品或服務)。

example.en: Budget planners must balance innovative design ambitions with fiscal reality.
example.zh: 預算規劃人員必須在創新的設計願景與財務現實之間取得平衡。

reviewWords.mnemonic: real (真實的) + -ity (名詞尾) ＝ 現實情況。

example.en: High-resolution product photographs must be uploaded to the promotional web catalog.
example.zh: 高解析度的產品照片必須上傳至線上促銷型錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: photo- (光) + -graph (寫、畫) ＝ 用光線記錄的圖像 ＝ 照片。

example.en: Our advertising firm hired a talented digital artist to design the corporate logo.
example.zh: 我們的廣告公司聘請了一位極具才華的數位美工設計師來設計企業標誌。

reviewWords.mnemonic: art (藝術、技巧) + -ist (人) ＝ 藝術家或平面視覺設計師。

example.en: Due to a schedule conflict, the executive director postponed the quarterly review meeting.
example.zh: 由於行程衝突，執行董事推遲了季度審查會議。

reviewWords.mnemonic: con- (共同) + flict (打擊) ＝ 互撞衝突 ＝ schedule conflict (行程衝突)。

example.en: The chief executive commended the entire marketing department for outstanding quarterly results.
example.zh: 執行長讚揚了整個行銷部門卓越的季度業績表現。

reviewWords.mnemonic: en- (在內) + tire (完整無損) ＝ 完整的、整個的。

example.en: Our firm seeks to expand its commercial market presence across Southeast Asia.
example.zh: 我們公司致力於擴大在東南亞的商業市場版圖與影響力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: present (在場的) + -ence (名詞尾) ＝ 出席或市場佈局 (market presence)。

example.en: Large crowds gathered at the flagship electronics store for the weekend launch.
example.zh: 大批人潮聚集在旗艦電子商城門口，參加週末的上市活動。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 形容詞 crowded (擁擠的)，多益交通與商展常考情境。

example.en: The new express cafe is conveniently located on the corner of Maple and Main Street.
example.zh: 這間新開的快捷咖啡廳座落於楓樹街與主街的轉角處，交通非常便利。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 店面位置或辦公空間：on the corner (在轉角)、corner office (邊間高階主管辦公室)。

example.en: Rental car agreements require drivers to return the vehicle with a full tank of gas.
example.zh: 租車合約要求駕駛人在還車時必須將油箱加滿汽油。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 租車與能源常見搭配：gas station (加油站)、natural gas (天然氣)。

example.en: Assembly line factory technicians work in alternating eight-hour shifts.
example.zh: 組裝產線的工廠技術人員採取八小時輪班制工作。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資班表必備：day shift (日班)、night shift (夜班)、shift work (輪班工作)。

example.en: The corporate annual financial report showed a twenty percent rise in net profit.
example.zh: 該企業年度財務報告顯示淨利成長了百分之二十。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財務必考對比：gross (毛利/總計) vs net (淨利/實收)。

example.en: Office supplies and packaging materials are filed under separate expenditure categories.
example.zh: 辦公用品與包裝耗材歸屬於不同的支出分類項目下。

reviewWords.mnemonic: cata- (向下、完全) + agoreuein (公開宣布、聚集) ＝ 分門別類。

example.en: The executive secretary scheduled all overseas video conferences for senior management.
example.zh: 主管秘書為高階管理層安排了所有海外視訊會議。

reviewWords.mnemonic: secret (秘密) + -ary (人) ＝ 保守機密並協助主管處理政務的人 ＝ 秘書。

example.en: Upgrading firewall protocols provides an essential defense against cyber intrusions.
example.zh: 升級防火牆通訊協定為防範網路入侵提供了關鍵的防禦屏障。

reviewWords.mnemonic: de- (遠離) + fens (打擊、抵擋) ＝ 擋開外部打擊 ＝ 防禦。

example.en: We appreciate your quick response to our urgent corporate supplier inquiry.
example.zh: 感謝您針對我們先前緊急的企業供應商詢價所給予的迅速回覆。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客戶溝通核心用詞：quick response / quick reply (迅速回覆)。

example.en: The hotel restaurant hired an executive head cook to revamp its dinner menu.
example.zh: 飯店餐廳聘請了一位行政主廚來全面重新設計晚餐菜單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 餐飲宴會核心：cook meals (烹調餐點)；head cook / chef (主廚)。

example.en: Word of mouth helped spread news of our annual discount sale across town.
example.zh: 口碑傳播有助於將我們年度特賣活動的消息在全城散播開來。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 資訊傳播 (spread the word)；金融名詞指利差 (interest rate spread)。

example.en: The power utility operates nuclear energy generators under stringent safety guidelines.
example.zh: 這間電力公用事業公司在極為嚴格的安全規範下營運核能發電機組。

reviewWords.mnemonic: nucle- (核心、原子核) + -ar ＝ 核能發電 (nuclear power)。

example.en: Automated warehouse facilities achieve substantial economies of scale in distribution.
example.zh: 自動化倉儲設施在配送物流中實現了顯著的規模經濟效益。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業擴張極核心：economies of scale (規模經濟)、on a large scale (大規模)。

example.en: Customer satisfaction remains the key driver of corporate revenue growth this year.
example.zh: 客戶滿意度依然是今年推動企業營收成長的關鍵驅動因素。

reviewWords.mnemonic: drive (駕駛/驅動) + -er ＝ 司機或推動成長的要素 (growth driver)。

example.en: The charity gala dinner was held in the hotel's grand ballroom on the second floor.
example.zh: 慈善晚宴於飯店二樓的大宴會廳隆重舉行。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店場地核心詞彙：ballroom (宴會廳、大廳)。

meaning: 大相徑庭(a far cry from)

example.en: The modern digital logistics terminal is a far cry from the cramped old warehouse.
example.zh: 這座現代化的數位物流航廈與過去那間狹小老舊的倉庫相比真可謂天差地別。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益聽力閱讀常考成語：a far cry from (與...大相逕庭、相去甚遠)。

example.en: The introduction of automated ticketing kiosks significantly shortened airport lines.
example.zh: 自動取票機的引進大幅縮短了機場旅客的排隊等候時間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: intro- (向內) + duct (引導) + -ion ＝ 引導進入 ＝ 引進、介紹。

example.en: A bachelor's degree in engineering is a mandatory requirement for this technical post.
example.zh: 具備工程學士學位是應徵該技術職位的必要必備條件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: require (要求) + -ment (名詞尾) ＝ 招聘徵才條件 (job requirement)。

example.en: The regional distribution hub is located twenty kilometers north of downtown Seattle.
example.zh: 區域配送物流轉運中心位於西雅圖市中心以北二十公里處。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通地理指引：North Wing (北側大樓/航廈)、north of (在...以北)。

example.en: The guest requested another room on an upper floor away from street traffic noise.
example.zh: 該房客要求換到遠離街頭交通噪音的高樓層另一間客房。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店服務與更換選項必備字：another room (另一間房)、one another (彼此)。

example.en: Through consistent product innovation, our company has become a leader in green energy technology.
example.zh: 透過持續的產品創新，我們公司已成為綠色能源科技領域的領導者。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業發展歷程與地位轉變常態動詞：become a leader (成為領先者)。

example.en: The commercial bank offers very competitive interest rates on corporate expansion loans.
example.zh: 該商業銀行針對企業擴張貸款提供極具競爭力的利率優惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財務重要考點！名詞常考「利息」：interest rate (利率)；show interest in (對...展現興趣)。

example.en: Our international distribution network delivers consumer goods to over fifty countries globally.
example.zh: 我們的國際配送網路將消費性商品送達全球五十多個國家。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 跨國貿易與物流高頻考名詞：across the country (全國各地)、foreign country (外國)。

example.en: The facility manager decided to replace the old computer servers with energy-efficient models.
example.zh: 廠房主管決定將老舊的電腦伺服器更換為節能型機種。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 設備淘汰與更新對話常見詞：replace old equipment (更換老舊設備)。

example.en: Each team member is expected to submit a weekly progress update by Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 每位團隊成員均須在週五下午前提交每週進度更新報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：each 後接單數名詞與單數動詞。

example.en: The corporate foundation provides annual scholarships to local vocational school students.
example.zh: 該企業基金會每年向在地職業學校的學生提供獎學金。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業社會責任 (CSR) 與實習招募常考單字。

example.en: Passengers arriving late for boarding will not be permitted to enter the aircraft.
example.zh: 登機遲到的旅客將不被允許進入機艙。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通延誤與繳費罰款必考：late fee (滯納金/逾期罰款)。
